'''''Watsonia pillansii''''', the '''Pillans’ watsonia''', is a plant belonging to the genus ''[[Watsonia (plant)|Watsonia]]''.<ref>http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1557-61 REDLIST Sanbi</ref> The species is endemic to [[KwaZulu-Natal]], the [[Eastern Cape]] and the [[Western Cape]].<ref>http://plantsoftheworldonline.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:441967-1 Plants of the World Online</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Watsonia pillansii | PlantZAfrica | url=https://pza.sanbi.org/watsonia-pillansii }}</ref>
